source_text: Lectio de fornicatione Israelitae cum Madianitide et zelo Phinees. Ira Domini placatur; sacerdotium aeternum promittitur.
pass_a_gloss: Reading concerning fornication of-Israelite with Midianitess and zeal of-Phinehas. Wrath of-Lord is-appeased; priesthood eternal is-promised.
pass_b_english: The reading covers [[Israel’s fornication with Midian and Phinehas’s zeal >> Bible:Numbers 25:1-13]]. The Lord’s wrath is turned; an everlasting priesthood is promised.
